name: Spider’s Wrappings
body:
A psychopomp bounty hunter has taught you the trick of using spider webs to defend against the undead.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 9th, duskwalker, ward against corruption racial trait.

Benefit(s): So long as you have a spider web wrapped around some part of your body, the bonus provided by your ward against corruption racial trait increases to +4.
